A port reachable only by the listed resources of this deployment.

items.description: Reference to a resource by its stable id and resource type.

type.description: Resource type identifier that determines the specific kind of resource. This field is used for polymorphic deserialization and resource-specific behavior.

from.description:
Resources allowed to connect: Sandbox, Worker, Container or Daemon.
Required and non-empty. These access references are not lifecycle dependencies.

name.description: Unique endpoint name within this container.

port.description: Container port served by this endpoint.
